open_points.subject: public_op:source_folder.read_named_source
open_points.text: A ready `SourceFile` carries in `modified` the modification time A1 takes from the opened file, so its caller reads no metadata of its own.
open_points.question: Does `modified` exist only on a ready `SourceFile`, or also on rejected `SourceFile` values—and, if it exists on a rejection, is it populated when opened-file metadata was obtained or set to `None`?
options: Make ready and rejected distinct variants, with `modified` required only on ready
Make `modified` optional and always `None` on rejected values
Populate `modified` on rejected values whenever opened-file metadata was obtained
open_points.default_guess: Make ready and rejected distinct variants, with `modified` required only on ready.

witness.initial: A named regular file opens successfully, its opened-file metadata supplies a modification time, and its bytes have an unsupported signature.
events: `module:source_folder` reads the opened-file metadata and then rejects the file under A1 order 6.
One implementation returns a rejected `SourceFile` without `modified`; another returns the rejected `SourceFile` with the modification time already obtained.
outcomes: The rejected value has no modification-time field or has it as `None`.
The rejected value carries the normalized opened-file modification time.
witness.observer: `module:photo_delivery`, generated model validation, or a unit test inspecting the returned `SourceRead`

open_points.subject: public_op:photo_preparation.prepare_photo
open_points.text: The bytes of the source, its modification time (`modified` of the ready `SourceFile` that came with those bytes) and the configured time zone.
open_points.rule: Каждый такой символ, не объявленный в `module_internal`, отчёт проектора (`python -m tools.slicer report --spec <base spec>`) называет находкой `SLICE_IMPORT_UNDECLARED` (repair_class `spec`): его объявляют в `module_internal` или убирают потребность в нём
open_points.question: Rewrite the passage so the `photo_preparation` contract does not name the foreign `SourceFile` export when the operation receives only its modification-time value, or change the actual input contract and the complete minimal `module_internal` dependency surface consistently.
